title: Roblox Oof
blurb: The Roblox oof — the tiny death sound that became a generation's word for misfortune. Every Roblox death for over a decade played this exact clip, hardwiring it into millions of childhoods before it was retired from the game — which only made the meme stronger. Play it for any minor disaster: stubbed toes, failed tests, seeing the group project grade.
origin: Roblox's original death sound (2006–2022), retired from the game but immortal as a meme.
